name: Nissa, Vital Force
oracle_text:
+1: Untap target land you control. Until your next turn, it becomes a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.
−3: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
−6: You get an emblem with "Whenever a land you control enters, you may draw a card."
blocked_sentences: +1: Untap target land you control. Until your next turn, it becomes a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.

needs.what: a `duration: "until_your_next_turn"` option on the `animate` op (and on the keyword it grants), so a land becomes a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that stays animated through opponents' turns and ends in the controller's next untap step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `animate` takes no `duration` (op_options: colors, keywords, objects, power, subtypes, toughness, types, your_turn_keywords); op_animate in ops_characteristics.py always applies an until-end-of-turn animation and grant_keyword, so the land would stop being a creature at cleanup instead of lasting until Nissa's controller's next turn
